description: Wnode mesh task result envelope schema

task_id.description: The task_id from the original task envelope

output.description: The result data produced by the task, base64-encoded

logs.description: Ordered log lines emitted during execution (stdout capture)

execution_time_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from task start to completion

error_message.description: Human-readable error description (only present when status is error or timeout)
